requirements.need: Source must specify how the priority timing is decided—growth-stage window, soil-water threshold, or stress indicator—and the units or metric used.
Source must report measured inputs (e.g., mm or inches of applied water, flow units if relevant) tied to chickpea and distinguish crop water use from applied volume.
Evidence must concern chickpea (Cicer arietinum) under supplemental/rainfed-plus-irrigation, not a different pulse or fully irrigated cropping system.
